raw_sections.skills:
Skills:
Azure Services :- VM creation and configuration, Application hosting on cloud, Network connectivity configuration with on-premises network, Monitoring resources, VPN setup, DNS zones creation, Storage configuration, Vnet and NSG configuration,ACR configuration, SSL certificate creation, Managing and implementing AKS clusters.
Azure DevOps :- Configuration of CI/CD pipelines, writing dockerfile , docker-compose ,pipeline files. , Application deployment , build docker images. Bash scripts writing for application deployments, Traefik configuration, Version control using Git, Setup policies on repositories. Managing Azure Board- sprints, PBI, Epic for development tasks.
IT Infrastructure: -Managing IT issues and escalations– L1, L2, Windows and Linux administration, Servers and Network monitoring, Vendor Management, IT assets and S/W licenses management and purchase, MDM, Managing IT security, AD account creation and management.
